    Interval-finiteness of the cover for an acyclic quiver #

    If the quiver of the ray category P has no oriented cycle, the number of objects reachable from x by arrows strictly decreases along arrows. Hence an object of the universal cover reaches only finitely many objects, and every finite set of objects of the cover lies in a finite convex piece (hullFinite_of_acyclic).
